entries.description: Refused to loosen my own pre-set validation tolerance when the model missed the documented value by 1.3e-5. Loosening after seeing data is the post-hoc flexibility the protocol forbids. Asked the artifact instead — which agreed with the model and convicted the documentation.

FALSE ALARM I RAISED AND THEN RESOLVED: a re-run returned 9.9998e-01 vs 5.885e-02, which I reported as a stop. Cause was my own build-dir naming (objs_16 meant FRAC=16 then WIDTH=16, overwritten). Not preventive — the wrong result had ALREADY been committed along with an RTL edit; the alarm came after, not before.

findings.description: Seed margin measured from the RTL at five formats: every one clears the proof hypothesis |e_0|<=1/2 with 6.5x-8.5x margin. And the seed 're-derivation' is a NON-EVENT — LIN_C1/LIN_C2 are elaboration-time computed from FRAC, so nothing is hand-entered at a new width. Cost: ~3 minutes, measured not estimated.

eml_reciprocal.v's SEED MARGIN LEDGER documents worst |e_0| = 5.8840e-02 and 0.028% excess; the RTL actually produces 5.885312e-02 and 0.050%. Wrong in the 3rd significant digit. The 8.5x margin claim the proof consumes was correct, so no conclusion moves. Found by following that ledger's own instruction to re-measure rather than assume.
